mentions.name: Screenie
mentions.description: Screenie is an open-source kids' screen-time monitoring system that combines an Arduino device with a web app. Built as a holiday project as a bolder alternative to the many parental control apps that don't play nicely together, it measures children's screen time; the Arduino and web app code are open sourced for self-building, and a live instance is available to try online.
mentions.problem: The author was frustrated trying to get the many parental control apps to play nicely, so built a bolder new approach to measuring kids' screen time.
mentions.audience: Parents who want to monitor their children's screen time
mentions.source_excerpt: I just completed a holiday project this week to measure the kids screen time using an Arduino device and a web app!
